devops_step_template.description: 执行 Maven 构建并上传 Jar 包，支持 mvn deploy:deploy-file 或 curl 上传，兼容 Jenkins 凭据或 mavenSettingsXml。
devops_step_template.stageContent:
steps {
  script {
    def result = javaUploadPackage(
      targetDir              : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_TARGET_DIR,
      mode                   : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_MODE,
      uploadType             : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_TYPE,
      buildCommand           : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_BUILD_COMMAND,
      packageFile            : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_PACKAGE_FILE,
      pomFile                : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_POM_FILE,
      repositoryId           : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_REPOSITORY_ID,
      repositoryUrl          : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_REPOSITORY_URL,
      repositoryCredentialsId: params.JAVA_UPLOAD_REPOSITORY_AUTH,
      mavenSettingsXml       : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_MAVEN_SETTINGS_XML,
      cacheDir               : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_CACHE_DIR,
      groupId                : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_GROUP_ID,
      artifactId             : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_ARTIFACT_ID,
      version                : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_VERSION,
      skipTests              : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_SKIP_TESTS,
      verifyPackageFile      : params.JAVA_UPLOAD_VERIFY_PACKAGE_FILE
    )

    env.UPLOADED_PACKAGE_URL = result.uploadedPackageUrl
  }
}

devops_step_template.description: Jenkins 版本 git 代码 克隆
devops_step_template.stageContent:
steps {
  script {
    /***********************
    * 按顺序定义执行变量
    ***********************/

    String gitRepoUrl = params.GIT_REPO_URL.trim()

    String gitCredentialsId = params.GIT_CREDENTIALS_ID.trim()

    String gitBranchName = params.GIT_BRANCH_NAME.trim()

    String gitTargetDir = params.GIT_TARGET_DIR.trim()

    Boolean gitCleanBeforeCheckout = params.GIT_CLEAN_BEFORE_CHECKOUT

    Boolean gitChangelog = params.GIT_CHANGELOG

    Integer gitShallowCloneDepth = params.GIT_SHALLOW_CLONE_DEPTH.trim().toInteger()

    Boolean gitEnableSubmodules = params.GIT_ENABLE_SUBMODULES

    Integer gitTimeoutMinutes = params.GIT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.trim().toInteger()

    /***********************
    * 按顺序调用公共脚本
    ***********************/

    def gitCheckoutResult = gitCloneRepo(
    repoUrl: gitRepoUrl,
    credentialsId: gitCredentialsId,
    branchName: gitBranchName,
    targetDir: gitTargetDir,
    cleanBeforeCheckout: gitCleanBeforeCheckout,
    changelog: gitChangelog,
    shallowCloneDepth: gitShallowCloneDepth,
    enableSubmodules: gitEnableSubmodules,
    timeoutMinutes: gitTimeoutMinutes
    )

    echo "Git 克隆结果：${gitCheckoutResult}"
  }
}
